model.name: Flux 3 Klein 5.6B
model.description: FLUX 3 Image Klein is Black Forest Labs' distilled 5.6B image model for text-to-image generation and editing with up to 10 reference images. Maestro uses its native 16-step flow-map schedule and MMGP component offloading.
model.selector_help: Generate images or add reference images and describe an edit. Downloads about 20 GB on first use; Hugging Face access to black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein is required. BF16 weights use Maestro's memory manager. Layout boxes, masked inpainting and Flux 1/2 LoRAs are not supported by this adapter.

prompt: A tiny orange robot tending a rooftop garden at sunrise, cinematic natural light, intricate details, a sign reading MAESTRO
